product_metadata.title: BOURINA Throw Blanket Textured Solid Soft for Sofa Couch Decorative Knitted Blanket, 50" x 60" Off White
features: CONSTRUCTION & SIZE - Made of 100% high quality acrylic, very soft touch, cozy warm sofa throw, strong anti-sunlight and excellent fastness, The decorative pattern on one side matches the decoration of the room more. It measures 50 x 60", weighs 1.12 lbs.
QUALITY IN THE PROCESS -Use of high-speed weaving equipment, high knitted density, skilfully crafted design with geometric pattern and rolled fringed edges for a beautiful finish.

100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEED - Environmental printing dyeing doesn't shed and dust-proof breathable Bourina guarantees to provide 1-month return and replacement service and life-time free customer service.
VERSATILE - Perfect for snuggling up on the couch, bed, as decorative, movie theater, park, farmhouse, or Christmas gift, when camping for any occasion. not suitable for pet use.
EASY CARE - Machine wash, colors separately, in cold water, gentle cycle, tumble dry low. NOTE:There may be some color differences due to the different resolution of the computer display screen.
